effects.label: Shock
effects.description: The recipient cannot move or attack, and Passive Skills are disabled.Active Skill cooldowns continue to count down as normal.The recipient will continue to take 125% damage from incoming attacks.

effects.label: Weaken
effects.description: Increase the damage the recipient takes from all attacks by the indicated percentage.

levels.text:

bio: Matescu is the Nocturna’s greatest secret: a musician so skilled he can resonate with the fabric of reality itself… then tear it asunder like it was paper. He opens up the universe and forges extradimensional Shreds from his music alone, only for them to collapse when the song is done.
